styleBible: The visual style is a nostalgic, sun-drenched Mediterranean coastal aesthetic. Materials feature warm white-washed plaster walls, weathered red-brown terracotta roof tiles, and rough-hewn grey stone masonry for walls and bridges. The environment is characterized by a bright, clear midday sun that creates sharp, high-contrast shadows and makes the deep blue sea sparkle. Vegetation is lush and varied, including dense green hillside shrubs, cypress trees, and patches of wild yellow and purple flowers growing along dusty, light-tan dirt roads marked by bicycle tire tracks. The overall atmosphere is peaceful and evocative of a summer postcard, with high-fidelity textures on natural stone, aged wood, and woven fabrics. Lighting is directional and warm, emphasizing the three-dimensional forms of the architecture and the undulating terrain of the coastal hillside.

styledOpeningFrame.prompt: A high-detail, centered rear-third-person view of a cyclist on a dirt road overlooking a coastal village, following the exact layout of the whitebox. The cyclist and vintage bicycle form a single visual mass perfectly centered on the 50% vertical axis in the foreground, with the rider's back to the camera, wearing a light blue short-sleeved shirt, brown trousers, and a leather messenger bag. The dirt road descends between low, rough grey stone walls and patches of wildflowers toward a prominent single-hole stone arch bridge in the midground. Beyond the bridge, a dense cluster of village houses with white walls and red-tiled roofs leads down to a sparkling blue bay. In the far distance, a large, multi-story neoclassical building with a long facade sits atop a green peninsula. The lighting is bright midday sun, casting clear shadows. All gray whitebox residues, segmentation colors, and grid lines are replaced with realistic textures of stone, earth, and water. No text, UI, or lateral camera bias.

styledTriviews.description: 骑行者与自行车组成的完整人车一体轮廓，包含人物全身、双手扶把、车架和两只完整车轮
styledTriviews.name: 海湾骑行者
styledTriviews.prompt: A tri-view orthographic sheet showing the Coastal Cyclist from Front, Right, and Back views on a neutral light grey background. The subject is a male rider on a vintage dark-framed bicycle. He wears a light blue short-sleeved shirt, brown trousers, and a brown leather messenger bag slung across his back. The bicycle features thin tires, a classic handlebar shape, and a simple metal frame. The textures are realistic, showing the fabric of the clothes and the metallic sheen of the bike. The three views are perfectly aligned and ordered Front, Right, and Back, with no extra props or environment.

styledTriviews.prompt: A tri-view orthographic sheet showing the Stone Arch Bridge from Front, Right, and Back views on a neutral light grey background. The bridge is constructed from heavy, weathered grey stone blocks with a single wide, semi-circular arch. The top surface is a flat stone-paved walkway with low stone parapets. The texture shows moss and lichen in the crevices of the masonry. The views are ordered Front (facing the arch opening), Right (profile of the bridge span), and Back (opposite arch opening), rendered with clear architectural detail and no surrounding landscape.

styledTriviews.description: 位于远端半岛高坡台地、具有长立面、多开间与中央屋顶节奏的完整大型建筑

styledTriviews.prompt: A tri-view orthographic sheet showing the Peninsula Large Building from Front, Right, and Back views on a neutral light grey background. The building is a grand, multi-story coastal structure with a long symmetrical facade, multiple window bays, and a rhythmic roofline featuring small gables. The walls are a warm cream-colored stone, and the roof is dark grey slate. The architecture is neoclassical with clean lines and elegant proportions. The three panels are ordered Front, Right, and Back, showing the complete exterior volume of the building without any terrain or trees.
